requirements.title: Ecosystem Manager Handoff Package
requirements.description: Build an ecosystem-manager handoff package (brief.md, manifest.json, source-index) from a finalized backlog idea, carrying the target scenario, the resolved operation (generator vs improver), and locked/open workshop decisions, so ecosystem-manager can initialize or improve the scenario. Replaces the former direct ecosystem HTTP client / numeric-priority mapping, which was removed when the handoff moved to a package-on-disk contract.

validation.notes: BuildIdeaPackage assembles the ecosystem-manager handoff artifacts
Handoff manifest carries target scenario, operation (generator), and locked/open decisions for ecosystem-manager
Handoff package construction rejects non-idea backlog items

requirements.title: Ecosystem Task Integration
requirements.description: Ecosystem-manager integration available for backlog-driven scenario initialization: the execution preflight resolves whether a backlog idea targets a new scenario (operation 'generator') or an existing one (operation 'improver'), and the handoff package records that operation plus the target scenario for ecosystem-manager to act on.

validation.notes: Preflight derives generator/improver operation from whether the target scenario already exists
Handoff package records the operation and target scenario for backlog-driven scenario initialization
